name: Bauernhof Lechnerbauer
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Lechnerbauer in Ebbs is a traditional Tyrolean agricultural homestead. Accommodation options include comfortable holiday apartments and guest rooms offering scenic mountain views. The farm places high value on organic farming and local sustainability. Guests, especially children, can pet farm animals and experience farm routines firsthand. Its location in Ebbs provides swift access to the center of Kufstein and the Kaiser Mountains. In winter, top ski domains like SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental are within easy reach. The peaceful surroundings guarantee calm away from mass tourism, accompanied by hearty regional breakfast delicacies.
